sections.heading: Who is responsible
sections.text: This website, theotruss.com, is run by Theo Truss as a personal portfolio. If you have any question about your information, or want a copy of it or want it deleted, email theotruss@icloud.com.

sections.heading: What is collected
sections.text:
Browsing the site collects nothing. There are no cookies, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking of any kind, and nothing is stored in your browser.

The only information collected is what you choose to type into the contact form: your name, your email address and your message.

sections.heading: Why, and on what basis
sections.text: Information from the contact form is used only to read and reply to your message. The lawful basis is legitimate interests: responding to someone who has deliberately got in touch. Your details are never sold, shared for marketing or added to a mailing list.

sections.heading: Who else sees it
sections.text:
The contact form is delivered by Web3Forms, which passes messages on by email. Their servers are in the United States, so your message is transferred outside the UK, and they may hold a copy for up to three years. Their privacy policy is at web3forms.com/privacy.

The site itself is hosted by GitHub Pages. GitHub records standard server information, such as IP addresses, to deliver the site and protect it from abuse.

sections.heading: How long it is kept
sections.text: Messages are kept in the email inbox for as long as needed to deal with the enquiry, and are then deleted. Email at any time to have your message deleted sooner.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.text:
You have the right to ask for a copy of the information held about you, to have it corrected or deleted, and to object to it being used. Email theotruss@icloud.com and it will be dealt with within one month.

If you are not happy with the response, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk or on 0303 123 1113.
